title: watermark --input pair appended after both positional args — relies on typst/clap accepting interspersed options (persists from r1)
detail: The flag pair lands after the output positional. Works on the pinned typst 0.14.2 (verified: 8 suite invocations + committed bakes), but a future typst bump that tightens option/positional ordering breaks only the demo pre-bake, at runtime.
recommended_fix: Insert the watermark pair before template_path (options before positionals), keeping the False branch byte-identical to today's argv.

title: New real-mode B1 pin silently skips when typst is missing, even in CI — unlike the unit-file pins that panic
detail: The served-bytes guard (r1 blocker B1's only enforcement) degrades silently on a missing typst, while sibling pins fail loudly. Guard asymmetry; currently backstopped by the pinned+sha-verified CI install step.
recommended_fix: Mirror the unit-file skip policy: panic when envoy.get("CI") == Ok("true") and typst is unavailable, else skip.
